source.dataset: cmlarsen/fiction-baseline export at b464cac (EXTRACTOR_VERSION 1), 210 units, 71 author units
source.scope: chapter windows (scene-break split, target 2,000-6,000 words: closed after reaching 6,000 or at a scene break past 3,000; short tails merged), author-weighted (each author counts equally)
source.method: p5/p95 are weighted percentiles (linear interpolation between cumulative-weight midpoints) of per-window percentages over windows meeting the report floor in that mode, each window weighted 1 / (its author's eligible windows)

units.transitions: percent of eligible sentences containing or opening with a transition
units.pronounStarts: percent of eligible sentences opening with the pronoun
units.sensoryBalance: modalities: percent of sense words; senseWordsPerThousandWords: rate

bandStatus: Reference only: transitions, pronoun starts and sensory balance take no baseline argument yet, so nothing highlights against these bands.
